body:
Live workarounds. Each holds until its retiring item is fixed, then is dropped; the full original detail of each is a note on that item. Ten entries.

1. Session-blocking defect is critical (Greg, 2026-10-01; greg-decisions-provenance P21-P22): a root session silently parked, with mail and Resume unable to wake it, is TermAl's top priority until it is reproduced, fixed and independently verified. Covered items: w-25b4f98cec5f, w-f23a694c9bc5, w-e0f80b315a6d, w-4b192401033c, w-3bd74078208d; owner Termal::Opus2, design Termal::Architect2. Until w-25b4f98cec5f is fixed.

2. Silent session may be admission-parked: a session silent well past its expected reply, with mail to it showing "queuedBehindActiveTurn" and a preview like "Engram: Waiting/Unknown", may be parked by a timed-out turn-admission evaluate; mail cannot wake it. Tell Greg through Engram::Advisor that the session needs a Resume, naming it; do not keep sending mail. Until w-25b4f98cec5f (with w-bf01dfb87ef4) is fixed.

3. Check that a woken session started a turn: acknowledging, within the same turn, a message labelled "queuedBehindActiveTurn" deletes its queued wake. Sender: if you need the target to act in a new turn, check after its turn ends (termal_list_sessions); if idle and it has not acted, send one more short message. Receiver: act on mail read and acked mid-turn in that turn, or do not end the turn expecting another. A turn ended planning "next turn" with no message pending gets no next turn either; the coordinator's timed wake covers that. Until w-3bd74078208d is fixed.

4. Keep the focus on the held item until a carried gate lands: (1) while a carried gate runs, and until its verification appears on the item, make your last tracker act of each turn a holder note on the held item, or set the focus to it explicitly (an `add` or a note on another item moves the focus away; renewing or re-claiming does not move it back), and check with `show ITEM --notes --gates` in a LATER turn. (2) Make NO file edits anywhere in the session while a gate is carried, not even in another held claim's named root; reading, mailbox and tracker notes are fine (until w-dc682a89edd4 is fixed). (3) One carried background command per claim at a time: wait until the first run's verification appears on the item. (4) Make a holder note on the gate's item the LAST tracker act of the turn BEFORE the launch turn, then launch in the next turn. A host restart ends a carried run without a record; recover and rerun. Until w-072e84b182c7 is fixed.

5. No resume wait on carried gates: do not register termal_resume_after_test_runs on a carried full gate whose credit you need. Launch with --detach --notify <coordinator>, end the turn, let the coordinator's relay be your wake, close that turn with a plain holder status note, and read the record in the following turn. Until w-7e037bedc7fb is fixed.

6. Claude: no background tasks, no edits in notice turns: while you hold a claim you need credit on, use no Bash background mode (no run_in_background, no `&`, no sleep timers); run tests in the foreground and full gates with `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify <coordinator>`. If a harness notice starts a turn anyway, make no edits and launch nothing in it; end it and wait for mail. Never make a cosmetic edit to make TermAl record a change; ask the coordinator. The coordinator uses background timers only to time its own wakes and makes no source edits. Until w-df1ef323efe9 is fixed.

7. Read-only Codex children use their default shell: on Windows a read-only Codex child runs commands in its default shell (Windows PowerShell 5.1) and never requests shell=bash (the WSL launcher fails under the sandbox). Brief: "use your default shell; do not ask for bash; one git command per call, as `git -C <worktree> …`". This is the OPPOSITE of read-only Claude children (PowerShell denied, simple Bash reads only); do not reuse a Claude reviewer brief. If Get-FileHash is missing, compare with git (`git diff --no-index --exit-code A B`, or blob hashes). Until w-380e6ea9951a is fixed.

8. `termal` is on PATH: never put a backtick inside a double-quoted shell string (write patterns in single quotes or a file); never type `termal` as a bare command (it starts a second server against the live store); the coordination CLI is "$TERMAL_CLI" with its subcommand. To filter cargo's warning line, match `generated` or `(bin`, not the crate name in backticks. Until w-b9221a1b527a is fixed.

9. Install swap never leaves the path empty: the host spawns target/release/termal.exe by path. Build in a separate target directory or worktree at the exact commit, verify the hash, then do the rename-aside of the old file and the move-in of the new one back to back, never with a build between them. Children spawned after the install run the new binary against the old host until Greg restarts. Until w-5798a85f3f4b is fixed.

10. Claude reviewer weekly limit (dated, not item-bound): until 2026-10-08 08:00Z (01:00 America/Los_Angeles), spawn Claude reviewer children with model "claude-fable-5-1" (writePolicy readOnly); that is still the Claude vendor, not a stand-in. A default-model child that runs normally is a valid Claude review. Record any refusal verbatim on the item; if a Fable-model Claude reviewer is also refused, spawn nothing further: an unavailable Claude reviewer has no stand-in, and the item waits for the reset. Revise this entry with the outcome of the first Fable-model reviewer spawn. Recorded outcome: Fable-model Claude reviewers have run normally, e.g. Termal::Coder's pair child session-9999 (delegation 8b53de62, model claude-fable-5-1) completed its review with no refusal on 2026-10-03 about 01:53Z (TermAl mailbox 241329fa #489). Drop this entry after 2026-10-08 08:00Z.
